title: Existing-Home Sales (NAR, August 2026 data) — the missing September edition, 10:00 a.m. ET inside the Fed blackout
source: EST: nar.realtor/press-releases/nar-statistical-news-release-schedule, fetched direct 2026-09-08 (HTTP 200), whose 2026 table reads "Thursday, September 10 | August Existing-Home Sales" under the page's standing note "All releases at 10 a.m. Eastern Time". Independently corroborated by NAR's own live statistics page, quoted verbatim inside this calendar already — the confirmed existing-home-sales-2026-11-12 entry cites it as "Existing-Home Sales for August 2026 will be released on Thursday, September 10, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. Eastern" — and by a second search relay of the same sentence this session. Filed `estimate` rather than `confirmed` on the one count that is not date doubt: this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, the same limit the existing-home-sales-2026-11-12 proposal recorded on 2026-09-06 before that event's own initial research promoted it on the identical page. Checked 2026-09-08
notes: DISCOVERED during the fomc-2026-09-16 pulse-check adjacency sweep (2026-09-08, D-8). The gap it fills: this calendar tracks the November (11-12) and December (12-09) editions of NAR's Existing-Home Sales and nothing between, so the August edition — the only one that prints inside the 2026-09-05 -> 2026-09-17 FOMC communications blackout — had no row. It matters to this corridor for a reason that is about timing rather than content: it lands 10:00 ET on 09-10, the same session as PPI (ppi-2026-09-10, 08:30) and the ECB decision (ecb-decision-2026-09-10, 14:15 CET), one day before the August CPI that fomc-2026-09-16 has named as its fork, and with no Fed voice available to interpret any of it. Impact LOW and symbols empty, adopting rather than re-deriving the measurement the existing-home-sales-2026-11-12 ledger already ran on 122 EHS release days since 2016 (ITB 1.911% vs 1.839% baseline, p=0.40; XHB 1.693% vs 1.629%, p=0.46) — an inert tape, and nothing here licenses an entry. Sibling find in the same fetch: the August Pending Home Sales Index on 2026-09-17, proposed separately as pending-home-sales-2026-09-17.from-fomc-2026-09-16.json. Proposed as an estimate; estimates widen caution, never trigger action.
